name: diagnose
title_zh: 先复现再动手，定位是哪一阶段真的坏了
tagline_zh: 编译、签入、部署一挂，人第一反应是改代码；它偏要你先跑出一次稳定复现，再顺着阶段往下切，把「猜」换成「看到」。
tagline_en: When compile, check-in, or deploy fails, it makes you reproduce the failure first, then walks the phases to find.
desc_en: Use when a compile, checkin, or deploy fails, or the instance behaves unexpectedly — reproduce the failure and find which phase actually broke before changing anything. No fix without a reproduction.
why_zh: 它把「改一行试试」挡在门外：没有复现就不给修，逼你先确定坏在哪一阶段，而不是在整条链上乱试。
why_en: It blocks the 'change one line and see' loop: no fix without a reproduction, so you locate the broken phase instead of guessing.
limit_zh: 只覆盖编译、签入、部署三类失败与实例行为异常；纯逻辑设计问题、性能调优、需求歧义它不接。
limit_en: Covers only compile, check-in, and deploy failures plus unexpected instance behavior. Design, perf tuning, and ambiguous requirements are out; it.
title_en: Reproduce first, then find which phase broke
